description: Lightfield is an AI-native CRM that captures emails, meetings, and other customer interactions to maintain a continuously updated relationship record. It provides CRM records, workflows, and agent-assisted operations for sales and customer-facing teams.
summary: Lightfield exposes a beta REST API at `api.lightfield.app/v1`, a Streamable HTTP MCP server at `mcp.lightfield.app/mcp`, and an official `lightfield` CLI; the REST API and CLI use Lightfield-issued API keys, while the MCP server uses OAuth 2.1 via the MCP client flow.
